The audit counts **source primitives**, not distinct anatomical defects. In the
Male reference GLBs, 2,679 of 5,094 primitives have boundary edges and 204 have
nonmanifold edges or winding conflicts. Of the open primitives, 1,592 belong to
concepts made of multiple material pieces; the pieces may close when combined.
The 1,087 single-piece open meshes also include intentional sheets, cut skin
regions, vessel ends, and hollow organ surfaces. A boundary flag alone is not
evidence that tissue should fill its interior.

At the reviewed torso axial plane (70%), 99 flagged open primitives intersect
the plane. These include the derived skin, 18 named skin-region pieces, 11
fascia pieces, 33 vascular pieces, 13 muscle pieces, 4 skeletal pieces, and 2
digestive pieces. The per-part figures are in `local-reference.json`.

## Choices

| Choice | What changes | Benefit | Anatomical risk |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A. Review by tissue and concept (recommended) | Combine material pieces of one solid concept; retain narrow wall cuts for skin, fascia, vessels, and digestive lumen; repair individual solid concepts only after a screenshot and contour check. | Fixes false openings without inventing tissue. | Some source defects remain visible until reviewed. |
| B. Fill every closed-looking contour automatically | Bridge boundary loops and cap every mesh the algorithm judges solid. | Fewer immediate gaps. | Can seal intestines, skin, vessels, and spaces that must remain open; overlapping contours can create rotation artifacts. |
| C. Preserve source geometry exactly | Draw only the existing cut edge when a source primitive is open. | Avoids adding false volume. | Many muscle and bone sections remain visibly hollow. |

The current implementation follows **A** for reference bones, muscles, and lung
lobes. For example, the two rectus abdominis material pieces at y=1.05257 each
look open alone (boundary ratios 0.057 and 0.118), but the combined concept is
closed and yields a filled section. The right superior lung lobe at y=1.355
changes from three open cut edges to one filled contour when its intersecting
material pieces are combined. The duodenum remains a wall-only cut; its lumen
is not filled. `node scripts/inspect-cap-group.mjs <concept-id> <height>` prints
these contours and the cap choice for any reference concept.

## First individual review candidates

1. **L2 and L3 vertebrae:** their cartilage primitives at the axial 70% plane
   have boundary ratios 0.250 and 0.243. Verify against the neighboring bone
   primitives before adding a cartilage cut face.
2. **Serratus posterior inferior, left and right:** paired muscle/tendon
   primitives cross that plane and include a few nonmanifold edges. Review the
   combined contour from superior and turned views before any geometry repair.
3. **Longus colli, left and right:** each has over 3,400 nonmanifold edges in
   the source audit. Inspect where the problem intersects a section before
   deciding whether to repair or keep the source surface.
4. **Cavernous sinus, left and right:** roughly 4,480 nonmanifold edges each.
   Treat as a venous space; do not convert it into a solid block by default.

For every manual repair, retain source triangles and material provenance in the
import record, store the repair as a separate reproducible transform, and verify
axial, coronal, sagittal, and rotated views with click/hover selection.

2026-10-17 full-closure continuation: the uninstalled `male-filling-closed-v8` candidate corrects 2,578 lost lining classifications by proving complete facet coverage inside actual immutable fluid triangles. Recutting the missed closure boundary adds 144 source controls without moving source surfaces. Shared-axis reconciliation removes the assembled wall's 78 nonmanifold edges; whole wall and complete mucosa each have one closed, oriented genus-one boundary with zero invalid links. This does not prove separated, patent fluid domains or anatomical correctness.

Measured local curve refinement adds 3,500 shared source controls and reduces the examined worst midpoint-to-chord error from 1.459 to 0.617 mm. A further 634 controls target confirmed crossing facets. Ten fixed interface facets expose a limitation of vertex-only protection: the analytic field would move sampled interiors by up to 0.735 mm despite literal emitted vertices. Eighty-five additional source-facet witnesses now have zero closure weight; these samples do not establish protection over every facet interior. All 3,950 actual external facets remain literal.

Open3D candidates replayed against strict original-triangle predicates find 9 whole-wall and 27 complete-mucosa crossing pairs, versus 11 and 415 before the targeted repair. The current six mucosal regional cells still have nonmanifold contact edges. The largest current cell volume ratio is 1.998, and the deliberately unconstrained volume-preservation control still spans 0.917–1.151; neither establishes an acceptable tissue deformation. The actual normal loader retains 656 thoracic context records. Both native ITA stems are unbranched 109-station outer casts, diameter 2.462–2.676 mm, with no existing branch sockets. Complete source checks find 89 sternal and 30 fourth-costal-cartilage crossing pairs per side; all distal-ring points are also bracketed by literal posterior/anterior sternal faces. The sternal source has open edges, so this slice evidence is not certified closed-solid containment. Source subclavian/terminal cast interfaces have no matched annuli.

One coupled C2 proper-ring proposal moves the bilateral ITA, musculophrenic and superior epigastric source assembly while preserving source sections, all faces/UVs and distant controls. Its first execution stopped after 2.44 s on disconnected-component face indexing; the corrected continuation replayed saved geometry/normals exactly and finished in 3.07 s. Independent six-owner array replay passed. Complete left/right 656-owner audits took 15.21/7.35 s: the proposal clears the sternum but creates pulmonary-artery, pleural and transversus contacts. **Rejected; not installed.** Source superior-epigastric self-crossings remain 38→38, rather than being falsely counted as a new defect. Evidence: `thoracic-parietal-vascular-family-v1/one-parasternal-family-candidate-v8/`, `complete-current-context-candidate-v9-l/`, `complete-current-context-candidate-v9-r/`, and `candidate-replay-and-comparison-v10/`. Next construction requires a coherent two-sided native tissue corridor and actual signed source-face constraints, not another offset trial. All 27 missing branch terms above remain missing.

Independent full-source compartment checks distinguish physical penetration from adjacency: native transversus thoracis is one closed manifold component, and multiple candidate course stations lie between its actual source surfaces. Sparse lateral measurements at 5/10/15/20 mm from the measured sternal edge do not establish a continuous source-calibre route: all four sampled choices are narrower than 2.46 mm at bilateral stations 83–87, 89 and 97–101; right also 58–59 and 74. This is a qualified failure of those measured choices, **not** a proof that every 3D route is impossible. Missing ray hits stay unknown. Evidence: `ita-candidate-ap-corridor-independent-v1/`, `ita-parasternal-grid-independent-v1-l/`, and `ita-parasternal-grid-independent-v1-r/`. No new QP or geometry is justified until anatomically signed, compatible corridor constraints are established; reuse `geometry_tools/algorithms/section_course_qp.py` when they are.

### 2026-10-23 coeliac/cystic exact source composition contract

The complete blood terminology inventory remains `reports/ta98-blood-circulation-inventory-installed-v12.json`; the applicable coeliac-family source/parent inventory is `.local-models/geometry-workbench/circulatory-completion/male-coeliac-four-port-v1/coeliac-source-bound-inventory.json`, with the existing liver inventory and represented hepatic regions retained. This operation adds no term mapping and no inferred microscopic layers. Its whole communicating assembly comprises `ZA:Coeliac trunk`, `ZA:Left gastric artery`, `ZA:Splenic artery`, and `TA98HEPATIC:male:artery`. The ten selectable hepatic surface views remain regions A12.2.12.015, .029, .030, .032–.038; they are subsets of the single physical arterial owner, not additional overlapping tissue.

Before emission, actual source replay identifies the same 40,954-face completion-v186 hepatic carrier in both histories. The coeliac repair removes 802 source faces and contributes 138 exact replacement faces, including its 55-face annular wall interface. The installed cystic-v43 repair removes 118 different source faces and contributes 712 replacement faces, including the 36-face reciprocal cystic interface. The removed source stencils do not intersect; 40,034 carrier faces, all literal corner normal words/signs, and their ownership tags agree in both histories. Changed source supports are separated by at least 41.466 mm between their vertices. These facts establish a source-domain composition opportunity, not anatomical acceptance.

The one candidate will retain the current cystic artery, its gallbladder recipient/tip, current hepatic distal branch construction and all unaffected source faces and attributes literally; it will replace only the coeliac proximal carrier stencil with the already emitted coeliac faces. No whole-tree deformation, smoothing, inferred junction disk, skeleton/heart/coronary movement, or rollback of the newer cystic bank is authorized by this contract. Both reciprocal wall annuli must remain exact with opposed triangles and normal words. Candidate face ancestry must identify its current-v43 or coeliac-v2 source and inherited native face where available. ### Whole assembly and planned interfaces

The assembly is the current native thoracic aortic course; original outer positions, normals and pose remain fixed. Source: Z-Anatomy original Blender model, CC BY-SA 4.0, chunk 30 (`geometry-030.bin`), 444 vertices, 864 triangles. Planned finite coats outside to inside: **tunica externa (.017), tunica media (.019), tunica intima (.018)**. Four shared interfaces bound three disjoint tissue coats. The proposed **1.2 mm total thickness is illustrative**, not measured histology. This stage authorizes no outer offset, course adjustment, branch transplant or skeleton movement.

Lumen is a void bounded by intima, never a solid plug. Two original source end-mouth curves receive only annular closures of tissue between corresponding inner/outer rings, retaining the central passage. Adjacent coats must share literal interface coordinates and reciprocal normals, without overlapping volumes. Source branch-root proximity does not create an ostium. Native outer geometry alone does not prove a finite wall. Arch proximally, abdominal aorta distally and current posterior intercostal, subcostal, superior phrenic and oesophageal carriers remain fixed; their joins stay explicitly unverified until actual corresponding mouths are checked. The bilateral native lateral circumflex femoral source has two self-crossing-free open components per side. Its transverse course has 290 strict femur crossing pairs per side; the whole family is not ready for installation. The ascending course is separately free of detected bone crossings, but its source root arrangement is unverified. The pancreatic joint numerical solve failed without mapping geometry. All right sides are nonnegative, so weakening the ramp cannot restore feasibility. Do not repeat or enlarge the same single-direction cage. ## Reusable donor registration for future nervous and lymphatic imports — 2026-10-26

Requested by the user. The current task remains blood circulation; this note preserves reusable information for the planned nervous and lymphatic imports. No nervous or lymphatic geometry has been imported or replaced in this step. All donor assets remain local because redistribution rights are unverified.

Evidence base `B`: `.local-models/geometry-workbench/biodigital-male-circulation-v1/`.

| Stage | Saved definition under B | Reuse policy |
|---|---|---|
| Source decoding | `source-v2/manifest.json`, `source-v2/ownership-forest.json`; `scripts/biodigital_blood_source.py` | Replay each new system's original object matrices and shared assets. Preserve source IDs, pivot transforms and mirrored winding. Source units were undeclared; do not assume centimetres. |
| Whole-body coordinate registration | `global-envelope-v1/global-skin-similarity-v1/registration-candidate.json` | This is the complete proper similarity **Gnew**, from original donor world coordinates to recipient metres. Reuse as the initial frame only after confirming the new source system uses the same donor body/world frame. |
| Common body-pose/envelope candidate | `global-envelope-v1/body-envelope-map-proposal-v2/{contract.json,body_field.py}` | Apply after Gnew. Ordered actual skin sections guide a monotone X map and positive AP scaling/shift; Y stays fixed. Central torso/head preserve Gnew. Reuse as a candidate for related systems, then check their own anatomical interfaces. |
| Local blood correction | `lower-limb-joints-v4/contract.json` | Apply after the body map. These measured deep knee corridors are **not** part of the coordinate registration. Transfer to a future nerve/lymph assembly only where a declared shared bundle and independent interface checks justify it. |

The intended sequence is **original world transforms → Gnew → body-envelope v2 → explicitly justified local fields**. Version alternatives are replacements, not a chain of v1→v2→v3 fits. The early torso-only registration and coarse bone-centroid fields should not be reused: they missed body height and could compress vessels. The donor skin originally spanned about 1.872 m versus the fixed recipient's 1.830 m; donor-skin registration corrected scale and ground without treating vessel extrema as anatomical landmarks.

Reuse these lessons:

- Keep the skeleton, skin and other recipient anatomy fixed. Build the complete source dependency forest first. Organizational source groups can contain anatomically foreign members: the donor “Hepatic veins” organizer also contains portal/gastric/splenic vessels. Validate named members rather than trusting the group title.
- Use one shared spatial map for a communicating assembly, with the full chain-rule Jacobian and inverse-transpose Jacobian normal transport. Preserve source UVs and source-face ancestry. The blood import excluded only literal zero-area source faces; do not assume a new system has the same degeneracies or tissue types.
- A nearest triangle's normal sign is **not** a body-inside test. It falsely reported a central pulmonary point 111.7 mm outside; complete section winding and independent all-intersection rays placed it inside. Use `geometry_tools.oriented_rays`, localized open-boundary uncertainty and actual triangle crossings. Bounding boxes alone establish neither containment nor clearance.
- Verified hand boundary networks are covered T-junctions, not holes to cap. Crown, sole and other skin openings/seams still require explicit uncertainty. Synthetic classifier patches cannot establish tissue clearance. See `global-envelope-v1/fixed-skin/envelope-topology-v1/`.
- Skin margins are local: current targets are 2.5 mm for trunk/major limbs and 0.5 mm for fingers, toes, penis and other genuinely thin features. The user rejected a universal 5 mm setback.
- A positive Jacobian alone does not preserve a tube's calibre. Broad knee translations pushed superficial saphenous veins outside; a narrow ellipsoid then compressed popliteal walls. The final corridor follows measured arterial/venous sections, translates complete transverse sections together, and excludes the measured superficial X/Y regions. `geometry_tools/algorithms/compact_positive_fields.py` and its tests retain these reusable maps.
- Lower-leg fitting needs different treatment for deep bundles and superficial vessels. A common bone-pose similarity clears measured deep bundle sections but pushes superficial veins outside the fixed skin. One constrained ARAP diagnostic preserved nine vessel cross-sections but folded 65 cage cells and is rejected; no such fit was installed. Retain this negative evidence before reusing a regional map for nerves or lymph. See `lower-leg-coherent-fit-v1/` under B.
- Check all actually moved vertices **and** triangles, plus fixed-bone contacts and complete main-vessel deformation. Keep inherited defects separate from new regressions. Current blood review remains incomplete; local no-regression passes are not whole-body acceptance.
- TA98 source identities and complete anatomical representations are separate. The current mapped snapshot has 607/1,149 historical blood terms plus four cross-root terms; 306 plural-family members are explicitly qualified. This counts source identities, not anatomically accepted fits. Future nerves/lymph require their own authoritative inventory and sensible hierarchy groups. Detailed brain/cord models can remain separate rather than flooding the body hierarchy.

Blood work order remains: lower-limb joints → penis → heart vessels → head → upper-limb joints → palms → fingers. Reuse the metered job wrappers and saved receipts; do not restart a system-wide memory observer or modify `.gitignore` for these imports.

**Brain decision: retain the existing TA98 brain.** The decoded neural inventory contains 197 genuine named regions versus 88 donor placements. Actual decoded geometry gives 76 laterality-specific named cortical regions versus 36 donor placements; cortical triangle counts are comparable (71,340 versus 74,536 placed), so this choice is not based on polygon count alone. The existing cerebellum has 35 named meshes and 150,625 triangles versus one 1,260-triangle donor cerebellum. Existing brainstem detail is 40 named meshes/52,828 triangles versus eight/4,370 in the donor. Existing deep cerebral/diencephalic/white-matter meshes add further detail. The audit excludes eye/lacrimal objects and cranial nerves from brain parenchyma and keeps sulcal/fossa surface patches separate. See `brain-source-comparison-v1/comparison.json` under B (SHA256 `bbf685cc787517177008c7e9f4c3d047dff8d699471f5e31bee5c6679d0d1e9a`). This is a detail/coverage decision from decoded sources, not a rendered anatomical acceptance or placement certificate. Neither brain has been replaced; future peripheral-nerve fitting must check its interfaces with the retained brain and cord.

### Renal root diagnostic outcome v1353

Actual source-mouth survey identifies four previously omitted vascular dependencies: both inferior suprarenal arteries, left suprarenal vein and left testicular vein. A numerical boundary match does not alone declare patency; the left suprarenal mismatch is explicitly retained. Both main renal arterial sources have previously missed true 12/12/6/6-control root annuli, certified through actual source incidence and manifold annular bands. New root-section recovery preserves the source arrays and stops at branching. Proper section transport and exact fixed/moving target anchors are implemented with bounded graph solves, but the full 36-source candidates remain rejected: v1350 introduces 200 intrinsic pairs on five parts, v1351 264 pairs on five, v1353 269 pairs on six. All source branches retain their original faces; the left capsular arterial source already has 21 intrinsic pairs. Literal triangle front/uncapped oblique diagnostics were inspected at renal-root-render-v1352/roots.png. No new geometry installed; atlas remains v1346. Current capsule bounds roughly span the fixed T12/L3 vertical extents, while imported donor guides are superior to those targets; bounding boxes alone cannot establish anatomical correspondence. Next construct finite anatomical outer-envelope root collars from these explicit source annuli while retaining the original branching networks, rather than repeating global field or ARAP variations. Full wall/lumen, organ packing and anatomical acceptance remain unproven.

### Left renal venous sleeve assembly v1357

Seven explicitly owned venous sources form this partial assembly. The four intrarenal/capsular collections receive the existing left renal proper similarity. The main left renal vein keeps its original caval mouth and all distal branches; only a certified branch-free source sleeve is reconstructed. The left suprarenal and testicular veins keep all remote source tissue and mouths, while their renal-root mouths receive the same renal pose. Sleeve boundaries follow actual source annular topology, not assumed quad/distance layers. All removed source faces and retained branches carry explicit lineage. Source cross-sections determine positive projected channel areas; cubic courses must satisfy a whole-segment numerical curvature-extrema replay with a one-percent safety margin, without thinning to avoid collisions. New faces form only annular sides, with no lumen disk. Existing source mouth mismatch and unestablished finite walls remain explicit; these are outer vascular envelopes. The full blood authority and 84-term renal inventory, complete ownership forest, source arrays, code and interfaces are hash-bound before construction. All arteries, right venous anatomy, recipient organs and 888 skeletal items remain fixed. Actual surface/self/foreign-tissue and collecting-lumen checks plus rendered sections and packed replay are required before installation.

### Original hand bone-guided common-flow contract hand-bone-surface-flow-v1537

All 26 original left arterial/venous source members receive the same smooth time-dependent map defined by 19 paired whole-bone envelopes. Bone-centre/direction/width stations are numerical registration anchors, not anatomical reference labels. The target skeleton, skin and organs stay fixed. This replaces neither an organ nor vessel detail; every source control, face, material, original mouth and branch stays owned. The original source has fewer intrinsic defects than the distorted installed fit. Continuous flow theory does not establish the emitted coarse triangles, calibres, containment, clinical anatomy or whole patency. Full emitted-source, target-body and mouth checks plus actual surface/section review remain mandatory before any installation.

### Registered donor skin frame correction v1599

The retained donor skin used registration-v2 G only, whereas the paired hand bone guides and original registered vessel controls used global-skin-similarity Gnew followed by body-envelope-map-proposal-v2. Equal frame strings did not establish coordinate equivalence. Native skin now replays the same hash-bound Gnew and body carrier used by paired bones. Independent closest-surface diagnostic: original mismatched skin reports 21/38 donor bone centres outside, corrected skin 0/38, with zero unknown centre classifications. See .local-models/geometry-workbench/biodigital-male-circulation-v1/hand-native-source-skin-frame-audit-v1599.json. This fixes a reference transform chain only: no target skin/skeleton or installed vessel is moved, and it does not establish global containment or clinical anatomy. Subsequent numerical skin anchors omit recorded ray misses without substituted radii; full emitted candidate and packing checks remain mandatory.

### Original hand bone-guided common-flow contract hand-complete-midbone-skin-loops-v1603

All 26 original left arterial/venous source members receive the same smooth time-dependent map defined by 19 paired whole-bone envelopes. Bone-centre/direction/width stations are numerical registration anchors, not anatomical reference labels. The target skeleton, skin and organs stay fixed. This replaces neither an organ nor vessel detail; every source control, face, material, original mouth and branch stays owned. The original source has fewer intrinsic defects than the distorted installed fit. Continuous flow theory does not establish the emitted coarse triangles, calibres, containment, clinical anatomy or whole patency. Full emitted-source, target-body and mouth checks plus actual surface/section review remain mandatory before any installation.

The source and target skin sheets also supply three longitudinal stations × eight literal radial first hits for each paired bone. Both sets use the same proper bone-frame angular convention. Missing hits reject strict preparation; explicit --allow-unmeasured-skin-rays records and omits only unpaired slots, requires the declared numerical minimum 8 measured pairs per bone, and does not fill radii or establish unmeasured correspondence. All seven bone registration anchors per bone remain present; this skin-pair minimum is an initializer constraint, never anatomical acceptance. The source skin receives exactly the hash-bound G→body carrier already used by the donor bones and vessels. No target bone or skin moves. Full downstream body/mesh/packing gates remain unchanged.

Mid-digital sampling supersedes the three-station skin scheme above: only complete eight-ray loops at each phalangeal midpoint are used. Metacarpal/palmar and near-joint radial skin correspondences are not inferred. Explicit partial mode defers the whole loop if any of its eight paired hits is missing; all original bone anchors stay present. Deferred loops and unmeasured slots remain recorded. The maximum velocity-interpolation residual must pass the declared bound before any integration; complete body, surface, calibre and contact acceptance remains separate.

References: [official brachiocephalic TA98](https://ifaa.unifr.ch/Public/EntryPage/TA98%20Tree/TA98%20EN/12.3.04%20TA98%20EN.htm), [official azygos TA98](https://ifaa.unifr.ch/Public/EntryPage/TA98%20Tree/TA98%20EN/12.3.07%20TA98%20EN.htm), [oesophageal venous drainage](https://digitalscholar.lsuhsc.edu/som_facpubs/4342/).

### Labial arterial mouth repair v1756: pre-construction inventory

Two explicitly paired midline labial mouths only. Complete applicable descendants are inventoried below. Unchanged facial roots and septal branches are adjoining interfaces; skeleton, tissues, other blood and all unmatched mouths are fixed. No new face, radius narrowing or solid cap. Vessel envelopes do not establish finite walls or physiological patency. References: [cadaveric study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42380308/), [anatomic dissection](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18520400/).

Labial source-mouth delivery v1763: only the complete bilateral superior pair is installed. The 43.463671 micrometre rim discrepancy becomes 0.751624 nanometres after Float32 packing, with 12 collar controls moved at most about 22 micrometres. Original source faces, UVs, colors, normal signs and remote positions are preserved; local normals are transported. Complete native-context replay covers 1,010 source owners. No new nearby native/other-blood triangle pairs. Mutual source-envelope pairs reduce 20 to 7; three newly indexed face pairs are retained explicitly and bounded by opposed halfspaces in a 2.170849 nanometre source-seam slab. The lower-pair trial introduced a new orbicularis-oris face pair and remains rejected. Open-skin side classification retains 273 unknown controls; no previously known side becomes unknown and known outside controls remain zero. Complete walls, physiological lumen patency and whole-circulation acceptance remain unestablished. Actual front, back and uncapped midsagittal source-triangle views inspected. Source-mouth index: 451 head-vessel owners, 2,257 openings, 215 nonambiguous passing pairs, 179 near pairs and 29 unresolved carriers; unmatched ends are not automatically anatomical defects.

The open-skin test introduces no new known outside controls or known-to-unknown changes, but retains 2,460 unknown classifications.

All 54 tests passed (19 label/identity/batch, 9 source-mouth algorithm, 26 camera/explosion invariants). Local HTTP bytes and three route branches verified. ### Occipital artery follow-up disposition — v1996

No new artery geometry was installed. The last authoritative installed catalogue remains blood-installed-v1987 and its file/bank hashes and three route bindings were rechecked. Source-preserving skin-only v1990/v1991 retained all 222 arterial annular profiles and removed 61 skin triangle pairs, but increased active BioDigital occipital arterial/venous source crossings; it is explicitly rejected. This is not a mix with old Z-Anatomy circulation. Exposed whole junctions extend 13.05506 mm; a measured 13.1 mm physical support fixes the unintended remote mastoid motion from a graph-only neighbourhood. Independent nearest-exterior and lateral/inward directed-exit solves then stopped as infeasible without emitting geometry. Saved progressive halfspaces for the inward route isolate the first conflict to the ipsilateral occipital vein after skin, bone and native tissue constraints pass; removing movement bounds does not make those particular halfspaces feasible. This is not a proof that no other course/rotation can fit. The next fit must treat the source artery/companion-vein assembly together, preserve the already-installed emissary repair and fixed skeleton, and reuse the previous coupled-fit evidence rather than repeat its pinned-core failure.

Reusable exact-alias/profile/unrecovered-chart rigid grouping and bounded directed-local-exit tools have ten passing numerical tests, including open-envelope probe/exit and finite-ray rejection. No finite wall, clinical attachment or new TA98 identity is inferred. Head remains at 86 known skin-exterior occurrences, 920 intrinsic source triangle pairs and 69,509 unknown skin-side occurrences. Global circulatory perfection remains unachieved.

### Right scalp contact-cohort review — outcome v2026

The bounded v2020 query setup stopped on a Float32-collapsed native context triangle; no mesh was emitted. Full source-face motion bounds now exclude provably distant contexts, with literal Float64 BVH fallback available. The translation v2021 and small rigid-pose v2022 problems are infeasible while native galeal side constraints are hard. LP evidence shows those side constraints determine feasibility. Primary cadaver studies (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3941846/ and https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8141539/) support vascular/fascial supply and perforating interfaces, but do not establish the correctness of any particular atlas intersection. A predeclared local closed-loop passage review was therefore bound before v2024 construction; no anatomical host-volume acceptance was inferred.

Packed v2025 preserves 652 actual source annular profiles (maximum relative area error 0.000004773), all source faces/UVs/colours, 260 verified mouths and zero shared-coordinate spread. Source skin triangle pairs 97 → 0, 20 known exterior controls → 0, motion ≤0.418973 mm and rotation ≤0.05753 degrees. However, actual galeal loops changed 5→7, 6→2, 6→7, 6→7 and 8→7 across the five moved owners; the independent local-passage matcher rejected the changes. No new non-host contact pairs were measured. This candidate is explicitly rejected and never installed.

Restricting the relaxed constraints to original source contact faces is also linearly infeasible. Local probe results contradict a claim that fascia must be moved: sampled skin-normal profile widths 0.619–0.707 mm versus nearest-point projected skin/galea spaces 0.805–1.212 mm, with closest fixed bone 3.09–3.29 mm from the sampled galeal points. These are projections and nearest distances, not a perpendicular thickness or whole-route fit proof. The declared next action is flexible, barycentric contact coupling, preserving true profiles and matched contact endpoints without forcing a whole multi-profile intersection component rigid. No skeleton or fascia movement authorized by these probes is inferred. Current local route remains v2016. See local `scalp-coupling-outcome-v2026.json` for hashes.

### Installed head partial revision v2040

Installed the complete passing right parietal superficial temporal arterial source stage after preserving all original contact-face profile coordinates. Twelve source controls move at most 0.171182 mm; the 88 complete source profiles retain exact pair distances and zero measured relative annular-area change. Literal packed skin pairs decrease 49 to 45 and exterior source controls 10 to 9. No new crossings in 2,386 tested actual source/native/blood broad-phase pairs; all 260 verified source mouths and exact shared coordinates replay. Full signed-normal front/back and uncapped axial source renders plus actual skin/bone context were inspected. All other anatomy, skeleton and vessel branch detail remain literal; no new exact TA98 term or finite wall/lumen claim. The full installed head audit remains 451 source owners / 213 exact mapped distinct terms, 66 known skin-exterior occurrences (previously 67), 920 intrinsic source triangle pairs on 22 owners and 69,509 unknown skin-side occurrences. No whole packing or clinical acceptance. Fifty-one geometry tools, 68 hierarchy/source identity and 26 camera/explosion tests pass. Local HTTP catalogue and 23,964-byte bank hashes match on all three routes; registry 8,775 owners / 4,252 distinct geometries / zero errors and complete forest 7,123 assemblies, 1,864 relations, 888 fixed items, 577 declared interfaces / no missing endpoints refreshed. The failed right frontal stage remains unchanged. No cardiac identity/test was altered. All 26 camera/explosion tests pass. Total: 109 distinct passes, one disclosed unrelated fixture failure; repeated runs are not additional tests. Petrous ICA course remains unresolved. The visible free tunnel near the measured artery aligns with the local cochlear-nerve guide; proximity alone does not establish a carotid canal. Human CT and dissection references distinguish the inferior petrous carotid opening and its anterior relation to the jugular foramen: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9519627/ and https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10080110/.
